WRITTEN OFFER FOR CORRESPONDING SOURCE CODE
===========================================

AppSandbox includes the following components in binary form:

  * QEMU                          — GPL-2.0
  * GLib (libglib/gobject/gio/gmodule) — LGPL-2.1
  * gettext (libintl)             — LGPL-2.1

For at least three (3) years from the date you received this copy of AppSandbox,
the distributor named below will provide, to any third party, the complete
corresponding machine-readable source code for the above components — for the
exact versions distributed — under the terms of their respective licenses (GPL-2.0
and LGPL-2.1), for a charge no more than the cost of physically performing source
distribution.

The corresponding source is also published and available at no charge:

  QEMU     https://github.com/jamesstringer90/asb-qemu  (exact revision in VERSIONS.txt)
  GLib     glib-2.90.1.tar.xz + glib-2.90.1-homebrew-hardcoded-paths.diff
  gettext  gettext-1.0.tar.gz
           (the GLib/gettext sources are in vendor/qemu-ivshmem/source-mirror/ of the
            AppSandbox source repository)

Exact versions and checksums are recorded in vendor/qemu-ivshmem/dist/VERSIONS.txt.

PCRE2 (BSD) and the EDK2/TianoCore firmware (BSD-2-Clause-Patent) are permissively
licensed; their notices are in LICENSES/.
